supersedes.reason: The prior smoke exposed an integration lifecycle error before the optimizer step. Version 3 freezes the CPU-validated correction and does not reinterpret or retry the version-2 result.

scope.purpose: Prove that the corrected 4B LoRA Stage C path completes one exact-snapshot ReDCO update before authorizing a learning campaign.
scope.collected_groups: one or more complete same-snapshot groups; zero-signal groups may be skipped by Prime before the one effective batch

corrections_frozen_before_gpu_calls.snapshot_lifecycle: Accept multiple groups at the current policy version, accept monotonic version advance, and reject stale-version reopening. Prime remains responsible for one optimizer update per batch/snapshot.
corrections_frozen_before_gpu_calls.branch_randomness: Derive four distinct 63-bit action seeds from the recorded context trace id and target id; preserve distinct per-branch cache salts in every trace.
corrections_frozen_before_gpu_calls.action_parser: Accept exactly one unique allowed alias in either canonical action tags or the self-closing paired tag form observed in version 2; reject bare, invented, and ambiguous values.
corrections_frozen_before_gpu_calls.taskset: Use one task row per probe; Prime may proceed to later probes under the same snapshot until it obtains a nonzero effective batch.
corrections_frozen_before_gpu_calls.verification: Verify collected and effective trace streams separately and always emit a signed structured pass/fail record.

hardware.spot_policy: reject the resource if provisioning identifies it as spot or preemptible
prohibited: a second simultaneous Stage C pod

resource_policy.stop_if_prior_lifecycle_error_recurs: ValueError: clean Stage C permits one collected group per snapshot

mandatory: the frozen config, patch, runner, verifier, environment, contracts, and lock hashes match locally and remotely
exactly two complete effective episodes and ten effective traces are serialized
all collected traces form complete five-trace episodes and all collected and effective traces use policy version zero
each effective episode contains one context and branch indices zero through three
each effective episode records four distinct structural action seeds and four distinct branch cache salts
every effective branch action parses to an allowed displayed and canonical action
at least one effective episode has nonconstant counterfactual branch rewards
every target is recorded as committed before action sampling
all effective branch records report exact sliced/full reward equivalence
the optimizer gradient norm is finite and positive
a non-empty LoRA adapter is saved
decision_rule.failure: sync all available artifacts, emit a signed structured failure, terminate the pod, and do not start a learning arm
